arms.description: HAVEN on DeepSeek V4 Flash: no compiling testbench in five repair attempts (seq_item lacks the wb_dat_o field its template's monitor and driver read; its sequences carry SystemVerilog syntax errors)
2 replayable flows (leave reset; request a frame and see its start), JasperGold-derived, in HAVEN's bench with the one-field fix and its sequences excluded; capped at 300 us

engine_limits.partner: ack-once (one dominant bit time, engine picks the moment)

engine_limits.flow: busoff (bus_off_on falls) without a transmit request
engine_limits.result: unreachable, proven in 10 s (only the transmit error counter reaches 256)

engine_limits.probe: bind cover node_bus_off / tx_err_cnt>=255 with the drive free from reset
engine_limits.result: covered in 6-10 cycles: the transmit error counter register written 255 in reset mode -- the shortcut the flows' pinned writes exclude

traps: irq_on is the core's active-low irq_n
bus_off_on is high while the node is ON the bus
an interrupt line alone is satisfied by an error frame the engine provokes in four cycles; completion is the interrupt register's TI/RI bit
can_ibo.v has a port named `do`: vendored .v files are analyzed as Verilog-2001
bench_fixes: can_top_seq_item.sv: logic [7:0] wb_dat_o (the template's monitor and driver read it; the generated item lacked it)
can_top_pkg.sv: HAVEN's sequence_*.sv excluded (SystemVerilog syntax errors)
